shots.action: Mara sits at the wooden map table, unrolls a map, and lifts the brass compass; it trembles and turns away from north.
shots.camera_framing: medium-wide vertical shot, Mara seated left of frame, table and maps filling the lower half
shots.color_direction: warm morning gold, cream paper, deep teal jacket as the single saturated accent
shots.composition: attic studio interior, slanted window light from the upper right, maps pinned on the wall behind
shots.lighting: soft morning window light, warm, gentle shadows
shots.subtext: A mapmaker. A compass. Somewhere new.
shots.visual_direction: Attic map studio, morning light, Mara at the table with the brass compass.

shots.action: Mara walks the forest path, map in one hand, compass held out in the other; the needle glows faintly.
shots.camera_framing: medium shot, full figure walking left to right, path leading into depth
shots.color_direction: green forest with dappled gold light; deep teal jacket holds the eye
shots.composition: forest path receding to a bright gap between trees, ferns at the edges
shots.lighting: dappled daylight through leaves, soft contrast
shots.subtext: Past the blank edge of every map.
shots.visual_direction: Forest path, dappled light, Mara walking with map and glowing compass.

shots.action: Mara stops and looks up; the forest around her shimmers as the drawn world becomes real.
shots.camera_framing: close-up, face fills the upper two-thirds, shoulders visible
shots.color_direction: soft green bokeh, warm light on the face, teal collar at the frame bottom
shots.composition: face centred, compass light catching the cheek, out-of-focus forest behind
shots.lighting: soft diffused light, gentle glow from the compass below
shots.subtext: A hundred worlds drawn. Never stepped inside one.
shots.visual_direction: Close-up on Mara's face in wonder, compass light reflected, forest bokeh behind.

shots.action: Mara crouches by the stream and traces the redrawn map with one finger; the compass rests on the paper.
shots.camera_framing: three-quarter side view, Mara crouched at the water's edge, map spread on a flat stone
shots.color_direction: cool stream blues and stone greys against the warm skin and teal jacket
shots.composition: stream crossing the lower frame, Mara on the right bank, map on the stone between
shots.lighting: clear midday light, soft reflections on the water
shots.subtext: A stream, a stone, a door of flowers.
shots.visual_direction: Three-quarter view, Mara crouching by a stream, tracing the redrawn map.

shots.action: Mara runs across the wildflower meadow toward a stone arch; her jacket and hair move with the run.
shots.camera_framing: wide vertical shot, Mara mid-stride right of centre, arch in the distance
shots.color_direction: bright meadow greens and flower colours, teal jacket the anchor
shots.composition: meadow sweeping to the stone arch on the horizon, wildflowers in the foreground
shots.lighting: bright open daylight, long soft shadows
shots.subtext: Past every reason to turn back.
shots.visual_direction: Meadow run toward a stone arch, hair and jacket in motion.

shots.action: Mara stands in the hidden walled garden, smiling, holding the brass compass up toward the light.
shots.camera_framing: medium-wide shot, Mara centred, garden walls and flowers around her
shots.color_direction: golden hour gold and greens, deep teal jacket glowing warm in the light
shots.composition: walled garden in full bloom, stone arch behind Mara, flowers framing the shot
shots.lighting: golden hour, warm low sun, soft glow
shots.subtext: One compass. One mapmaker. Every scene, the same Mara.
shots.visual_direction: Hidden walled garden at golden hour, Mara smiling, compass raised.
